# Clear Wave

> Clear Wave is an iOS app that helps users restore muffled iPhone and iPad speakers using calibrated sound-wave water ejection and speaker test tools.

## Main Sections

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and FAQ
- [English](/): Primary landing page

- [Turkish](/tr/): Turkish landing page

## Key Facts

- Product type: iOS utility app for speaker cleanup and diagnostics
- Supported devices: iPhone and iPad
- Minimum OS: iOS 15.1
- Core tools: Water ejection, tone generator, decibel meter, stereo test
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6742754087
